incidents.summary: EPS bus voltage drop to 23.6V triggered automatic transmitter power backoff. Resolved by load shedding under COMMS-04.
matching_reasons: Identical EPS bus undervoltage trigger condition (23.6V vs 23.8V)
Matching S-Band RF power attenuation signature

incidents.title: Thermal Control Over-powering EPS Bus
incidents.summary: Secondary payload thermal heaters drew excess current during eclipse transition.

procedures.title: Communications Degradation & Voltage Load Shedding Procedure

steps.action: Check battery bus voltage on telemetry T-19281.
steps.rationale: Verify whether undervoltage is causing transceiver power backoff.
Ensure RF stage is not drawing excess current.

steps.action: Shed non-critical payload thermal heaters and switch to low-rate beacon mode.
steps.rationale: Stabilize main bus voltage above 24.5 V.

procedures.title: EPS Low Bus Voltage Emergency Recovery

steps.action: Isolate high-load payloads and command safe mode power profile.
steps.rationale: Prevent battery discharge below 22.0 V threshold.
